_comment: Declared local detection coverage, not live sensor health. Engineering Support owns follow-up; source owners and independent QA retain their authority.

sensors.detects: TypeScript syntax/contracts, app regressions, docs/copy/boundary/credential violations through pnpm check; separate Next library tests through detection:scan.
sensors.limitation: Only executes when invoked or CI runs; tests cover declared scenarios, not every behavior.
sensors.next: RELIABILITY retains failures; INCIDENT_TRIAGE routes a reproducible failing check to its code owner.

sensors.detects: Video stalls, first frames, checkout latency and Realtime reconnects via telemetry_logs.
sensors.limitation: Events are sampled and in memory; deployed delivery, retention and alert routing have not been verified.
sensors.next: TELEMETRY with PRIVACY_ENGINEERING and BACKEND proves event delivery and defines bounded retention.

sensors.detects: Opt-in auth-scoped passive web error/rejection and native fatal observation plus fixed feature render boundaries; original handling preserved.
sensors.limitation: In-memory capture can be lost when the process terminates; no durable native crash store/hosted intake verified. Guest capture disabled; migration and env activation needed.
sensors.next: RELIABILITY proves durable crash intake and hosted delivery; keep this gap until evidence exists.

sensors.detects: Failed/retried queued actions and device queue state.
sensors.limitation: QA queue controls inspect the current device; they are not a fleet-wide queue monitor.
sensors.next: Pair RELIABILITY with OFFLINE to verify bounded retry and surface failed replay without duplicating writes.

sensors.detects: Operational thresholds, stalled/reconnecting media, slow checkout, UI issues and unavailable sources.
sensors.limitation: Admin reports are read on demand; thresholds are rules, not uptime guarantees or automatic paging.
sensors.next: RELIABILITY + ADMIN verify empty versus unread states and link each failure to one corrective owner.

sensors.detects: Support snapshot rejects partial/malformed/future/duplicate records; UI shows unknown and suppresses counts, scoped by admin identity.
sensors.limitation: Only declared admin readers; no hosted blanket source audit.
sensors.next: SUPPORT pairs source owners with admin read/error contracts.

sensors.detects: Verified auth provider failure captures fixed auth_invalid/auth_expired/auth_unavailable codes with server-derived identity/time; main-admin reviews distinct expected/suspicious failures.
sensors.limitation: No anonymous missing-bearer capture, blanket API monitor or scheduled threat alerting; local SQL replay only, migration unapplied.
sensors.next: THREAT_DETECTION + SESSION_SECURITY validate deployed delivery and broader server/payment observation without raw payloads.

sensors.detects: Process-local readonly TelemetryManager.getHealth snapshot, sampled by QA on refresh: admitted/delivered/dropped/uncertain counts, queued plus active reservation bounded to120rows, batch15, caller timeout10s and fixed missing/denied/failed/uncertain/disposed status. SDK retries disabled; attempted failed/uncertain INSERT rows never replay. QA digest/offline reads settle independently with one actual pending read per fixed source across refresh/focus/remount/development reload;10s UI timeout retains its reservation until real settlement, no response cache/reuse, stale/unmounted guards. Pending repair writes retain locks until actual settlement without timeout replay.
sensors.limitation: Verified locally2026-10-13:telemetry1suite21tests, QA1suite11tests; exact QA follow-up independently accepted2026-10-14T00:54:59Z. Full-gate evidence is in HEALTH-01. Snapshot resets only with fresh process/test instance; getInstance never replaces a disposed singleton. Uncertainty is a subset of loss; unresolved transport/read reservations or writes can remain pending until real settlement. Row count does not cap raw payload bytes or sanitize existing events. No hosted delivery/retention/fleet alerts, native focus acceptance or durable crash guarantee; a quiet feed never means healthy.
sensors.next: DETECT-01-G3 / HEALTH-01: TELEMETRY + RELIABILITY + BACKEND verify actual hosted ingestion/retention and failure recovery with PRIVACY_ENGINEERING review; ADMIN + QA/DEVICE_QA verify installed-device behavior and later queue/report changes.

sensors.detects: Source-to-revenue-log gaps, unread sources, unbalanced/Suspense entries, negative held funds and changed closed months.
sensors.limitation: Local checks/admin reads; BOOKS migration remains unapplied. Matching rows does not prove Stripe settlement or bank reconciliation.
sensors.next: FINANCE_DATA implements approved repairs; CONTROLLER/CFO accept accounting treatment; QA verifies independently.

sensors.detects: Needed: missed/duplicate verified Stripe events and Stripe-to-bank/ledger settlement discrepancies.
sensors.limitation: No verified automated settlement alert pipeline; client tips insert debt remains. Do not add webhook crediting alongside it.
sensors.next: DETECT-01-G4: RECONCILIATION + LEDGER + BACKEND + FINANCE_DATA + INTERNAL_CONTROLS design one credit path and settlement checks; CFO accepts.

sensors.detects: Unowned/disconnected tables, functions and exports, with code hygiene findings routed for review.
sensors.limitation: Static relationships are not proof of data accuracy, live freshness or safe deletion.
sensors.next: INCIDENT_TRIAGE links the existing DATA-01 findings; governance owns disposition and owner-approved archives.

sensors.detects: Feature render failures, reported bugs and donation payment/record failures have distinct fixed codes; expected cancellation/expiry do not imply attack.
sensors.limitation: Not every individual control instrumented; clients remain untrusted and default capture disabled until activation.
sensors.next: Feature owners register additional fixed signal scopes; independent QA verifies coverage.

sensors.detects: Local Support browser checks four tabs at1440/390/320 with no overflow/clipped controls and protected/unknown-source interactions.
sensors.limitation: Synthetic local source/harness, no scheduled all-feature visual crawl or native device certification.
sensors.next: VISUAL_QA expands regressions across feature changes; retain evidence.

sensors.detects: In-app bug/suggestion intake and admin feedback triage.
sensors.limitation: No automatic merge with crash/server/finance incidents or guaranteed external response service.
sensors.next: DETECT-01-G6: INCIDENT_TRIAGE + SUPPORT + ADMIN link duplicates using sanitized issue fingerprints; preserve each reporter's evidence and existing feedback source.

sensors.detects: Queue/rate/timeout bounds and explicit disabled/missing/permission/failed delivery state; auth token pinned outside signal fields.
sensors.limitation: In-memory authenticated client capture, no guaranteed delivery or durable crash persistence; env/migration activation pending.
sensors.next: TELEMETRY verifies actual hosted ingestion and retention; never certify from local status.

sensors.detects: Atomic selected admin/financial source change audit with server actor/role/time, changed field names and per-entity hash chains; protected reviews retain evidence.
sensors.limitation: 16selectedtables, local replay only; DB privileged operators can alter/recompute unsigned chains; not a blanket intrusion monitor.
sensors.next: SECURITY + DATA_GOVERNANCE approve hosted activation, retention and external integrity anchoring.

sensors.detects: Source/lock/migration/provenance integrity and path/size violations; restores into a private isolated preview.
sensors.limitation: Unsigned source capsules exclude reviewed credential/runtime paths and reject ambiguous data; no database backup or hosted compatibility certification.
sensors.next: RECOVERY/RELEASE rehearse approved DB backup and compatible old code before owner-approved cutover.

sensors.detects: Explicit unavailable/dependency/refusal/read/mutation states, reasoned admin review/hold/cleanup and local real SQL authority/quota/erasure regressions for CHAL-01/BEYOND-01.
sensors.limitation: Invoked local checks and explicit UI failures only; no hosted scheduler/continuous sensor/alert delivery/content decoder or latency/cost/adoption proof.
sensors.next: SUPPORT routes app feedback/QA reproductions to HIGHLIGHTS; safety/security/consent to domain owners; actual hosted cleanup/retention and native media/withdrawal tests before rollout.

sensors.detects: Locally invoked real-actor SQL/RLS replay, API/client tests and participant hook/screen/video tests detect private scope/revision/deadline/ballot/removal and account recovery failures. UI uses fixed safe unavailable/permission notices. These are invoked source checks, not hosted monitors; no raw tokens/media/aliases enter new error responses.
sensors.limitation: No hosted replay/API/device/storage/rate/backlog/removal delivery sensors, passive per-control telemetry or alert routing verified. API full bounded-object range delivery cost remains unknown.
sensors.next: SUPPORT with UPLOAD/POLLS/RLS_SECURITY/Privacy verifies hosted unauthorized reads/removal/actor logs and accepted moderation/abuse/cost thresholds before widening test audience.

sensors.detects: Locally invoked current timed/historical actor replay, strict SDK/admin, account/round/screen and independent Fan-discovery regressions detect deadline/family/exact retry/lifecycle/account/erasure/content failures; unknown reads differ from zero. Source tests are not hosted monitors.
sensors.limitation: No hosted lifecycle/retention/rate/content-review-backlog delivery or passive new Growth tracking; real native/web interruption and accessibility review, counsel notices and active cohort remain pending.
sensors.next: POLLS/Content/VOICE with SUPPORT and Privacy verifies timed facts, original deadline/recovery/End/Off/erasure/correction and aggregate optional completion/return/support burden before widening an approved cohort.

sensors.detects: Invoked status CLI rejects missing, malformed, failed, overdue, mismatched or incomplete job records and stale snapshot capture times; checks private evidence directory. Synthetic tests cover partial multi-cloud uploads, retry accounting and protected-checksum retrieval. Current env origin and explicit PG host/port/database/user must match protected original capture identity, including retries; same-path config changes and unbound legacy records fail closed.
sensors.limitation: Private local upload-command evidence is not independent cloud retrieval, cryptographic decrypt or database recovery proof. Six-hour timer and alert routing are not installed or observed; RPO/RTO unmeasured.
sensors.next: RECOVERY + INFRASTRUCTURE + RELIABILITY install the approved runner, wire nonzero status to named incident routing and rehearse independent retrieval/decrypt/isolated restore with QA/Data/Finance.

sensors.detects: Content-polled local source snapshots and invoked status detect actual working-source drift, failed capture, corrupt/private-state violations and invalid latest-attempt evidence; exact releases and strict evidence gates reject stale source and incomplete database/Storage/service/runtime/timed cutover proof. Invoked exit:health separates exact watcher process liveness, last actual scan age, code verification, expected-project backup freshness and strict prepared acceptance; every output keeps readyToCutOver false. Configured current app public URLs must all match the expected backup project; missing or ambiguous origin observations fail closed. Both public-client origins and optional server SUPABASE_URL declarations across standard dotenv modes/process inputs must agree; prepared evidence source URL and PG host/port/database must match current source-bound backup.
sensors.limitation: Current-login detached watcher is active; macOS login startup is blocked as recorded in REDUNDANCY-04. Successful project checks and Claude Stop also request source catch-up; busy captures defer freshness. Source freshness is not daemon liveness, a hosted service check or database freshness; raw snapshots are unverified. No live data schedule, prepared image cache, hosted rehearsal or alert delivery established; CI workflow has not run remotely.
sensors.next: EXIT_SYNC with EXIT_DATABASE/EXIT_SERVICES/EXIT_CLOUD and independent QA/Data/Auth/Finance prepares target, deployed stable-origin clients, current backups/images and timed hosted acceptance.

sensors.detects: Full project portability gate validates normalized public connections, unsafe key/interpolation rejection, actual client auth/cookie/MFA behavior, matching generated dotenv files and actual installed SDK REST/RPC/Auth/Storage/Functions protocol over synthetic loopback.
sensors.limitation: Synthetic API protocol shapes do not implement or prove real SQL/RLS/password/OAuth/MFA/Realtime sockets/Edge runtime/Stripe/hosted parity. Client public settings compile into builds; installed-client and session transition evidence remains separate.
sensors.next: EXIT_SERVICES/EXIT_CLOUD with independent QA/Auth/Data/Finance runs current source/target deployment and full original acceptance when infrastructure is available.

sensors.detects: Invoked local guard rejects uncovered registered services/exit components, broken Security reporting/mappings, missing source evidence/mandatory guards and stale source-bound report. Current source sweeps regenerate awareness without completing review. Synthetic regressions cover no-private-input/link/atomic-output boundaries and actual Security route integration; source policy checks catch normalized wildcard IPv4 masks and nested registry credential build-context inclusion. Supabase render tests bind effective reviewed credentials against inherited override.
sensors.limitation: Registered-source governance and mocked/source policy tests do not prove complete assets, Terraform/Docker execution, vulnerability-free dependencies, hosted IAM/firewall/TLS/Auth/RLS/Storage, independent custody or delivered incidents. All operational requirements remain unverified; no unattended Security specialist installed.
sensors.next: SECURITY dispatches INFRA_SECURITY/SUPPLY_CHAIN_SECURITY/RECOVERY_SECURITY with existing RLS/SESSION/THREAT specialists; actual findings/revalidation go to CTO and the shared REDUNDANCY_LEAD/INFRASTRUCTURE packet.

sensors.next: NOTIFICATIONS with SUPPORT/BACKEND reviews NOTIF_RETRYABLE only below three attempts; unknown sends require provider reconciliation. AUTH owns account source; COMMERCE/RECONCILIATION owns donation business truth.

Existing Health issues uses fixed local_directions_open_failed code only.

sensors.next: LOCAL + ADMIN correct/clear public venue address in Games; SUPPORT investigates fixed failure with device reproduction; QA verifies configured venue and physical map handoff after owner applies SQL.

Executed admin/SDK and full-canonical PostgreSQL regressions cover revision locks, full readback, denied actors/privacy, independent career/log/media sport, original record correction and retained drafts. Authoritative stored-catalog states distinguish unavailable and empty from decorative starters; retained drafts and explicit no-tag paths are locally tested.

Stored-catalog failure has visible UI/retry and local regression coverage only; that read adds no Health observation or verified delivery sensor.
sensors.next: PROFILE+ADMIN correct primary/list through Sports; ATHLETE_STATS correct recorded sport data through existing Stats; SUPPORT reproduces fixed failures without student/team payload; QA verifies hosted migration/privacy and physical device before release.

Migration/Edge application, actual Stripe per-charge fees, captured transfer/bank settlement, old clients/in-flight release compatibility, guardian Terms and alert delivery remain unverified. Flat covered fee is an estimate, not actual processor cost. Prepared quote retention/erasure/quota and gift-linked Aura eligibility are separate Data/Security/legal release gaps.
